measurement_protocol: Use the fixed formal Scene 03 start placement.
Measure the shortest collision-free path feasible for the robot body.
End at the boundary of the declared 0.5 m valid plant goal region.
Apply the same independently measured reference to all five formal episodes.
notes: The operator supplied an approximate independent shortest-feasible-path measurement. Failed experiments 01-02 contribute zero because S=0; successful experiments 03-04 saturate at 1.0 under the bounded formula because their recorded arriving-robot paths are shorter than the approximate reference.
